verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for an authentication product, but the pack documents no public API for Microsoft Authenticator. Every documented capability (approving sign-ins, OTP codes, backup, export, Verified IDs) is a UI action in the mobile app, and probes found no OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
